puzzle.hint: The Messenger's plea to Allah regarding his people treating the Qur'an as something they turn away from.
puzzle.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًۭا
puzzle.verseEn: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’ān as [a thing] abandoned."
